questions.stem: A young woman presents to the clinic with a history of a breast lump. On examination, the axillary lymph nodes are enlarged. The biopsy of the lump shows the presence of medullary carcinoma of the breast. Which of the following statement is true regarding the given condition?

options.label: A
options.text: Lymph nodes enlargement can be due to reactive hyperplasia

options.label: C
options.text: Majority of the tumours are triple positive

options.label: D
options.text: Has a poorer prognosis than invasive lobular carcinoma.
